messages.subject: Extract P(>|z|) values from s4 class and write to data.frame
parts:
Hello
I am trying to write p values for my models written to a data.frame.

ark <- unmarkedFrameOccu(y=i, siteCovs = cov)

mbatch1 <- occu(~1 ~1, data=ark)

summary(mbatch1) #gives the following output
Call:
occu(formula = ~1 ~ 1, data = ark)

Occupancy (logit-scale):
 Estimate   SE    z P(>|z|)
      2.1 1.08 1.95  0.0516

Detection (logit-scale):
 Estimate    SE    z P(>|z|)
    0.928 0.359 2.58 0.00982

AIC: 56.65071
Number of sites: 9
optim convergence code: 0
optim iterations: 17
Bootstrap iterations: 0

str(summary(mbatch)) #gives more detail
Call:
occu(formula = ~1 ~ 1, data = ark)

Occupancy (logit-scale):
 Estimate   SE    z P(>|z|)
      2.1 1.08 1.95  0.0516

Detection (logit-scale):
 Estimate    SE    z P(>|z|)
    0.928 0.359 2.58 0.00982

AIC: 56.65071
Number of sites: 9
optim convergence code: 0
optim iterations: 17
Bootstrap iterations: 0

List of 2
 $ state:'data.frame':    1 obs. of  4 variables:
  ..$ Estimate: num 2.1
  ..$ SE      : num 1.08
  ..$ z       : num 1.95
  ..$ P(>|z|) : num 0.0516
 $ det  :'data.frame':    1 obs. of  4 variables:
  ..$ Estimate: num 0.928
  ..$ SE      : num 0.359
  ..$ z       : num 2.58
  ..$ P(>|z|) : num 0.00982

y <- mbatch@estimates[["state"]]#at the moment i just want the state p value

str(summary(y))
Occupancy (logit-scale):
 Estimate   SE    z P(>|z|)
      2.1 1.08 1.95  0.0516
'data.frame':    1 obs. of  4 variables:
 $ Estimate: num 2.1
 $ SE      : num 1.08
 $ z       : num 1.95
 $ P(>|z|) : num 0.0516

I have not been able to call $ state:'data.frame': to separate it out into an independent data frame.  The information is there I just can't call it with @ or $.
Does anyone have in insights into how I would do this I have reached the end of my R knowledge. Thanks in advance.
Cheers Chris

s$state$P
